title: An Exploratory Replica-Overlap Probe of the Grokking Transition
abstract: arXiv:2609.25634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We trained 64 independently seeded networks in four configurations, continuing each to sustained convergence or a 40,000-epoch ceiling. We then asked whether an RSB-inspired distribution of pairwise weight overlaps changes across the grokking transition. It is the alignment step, not the overlap statistic, that determines what this registered probe can report. The registered implementation permutes hidden units without the corresponding bias and head-internal permutations and therefore does not preserve the network function. Every q_wt value computed through this alignment inherits the defect; q_fn does not, because it is computed from predictions of the unpermuted models. The numerical-precision requirement also failed, and an audit found protocol deviations. translated_title: 关于顿悟转变的探索性副本重叠探针研究
translated_abstract: 我们在四种配置下训练了64个采用独立随机种子初始化的网络，每个网络持续训练至达到稳定收敛或40,000个训练周期的上限。随后我们探究：受副本对称破缺（RSB）启发的成对权重重叠分布，在顿悟转变前后是否发生变化。决定该预注册探针所能报告内容的，是对齐步骤本身，而非重叠统计量。预注册实现中对隐藏单元进行置换时，并未对偏置以及注意力头内部的置换做相应处理，因此无法保持网络函数不变。通过该对齐方式计算得到的每一个q_wt值都继承了这个缺陷；而q_fn不受影响，因为它是基于未做置换的模型的预测结果计算的。数值精度要求同样未能满足，且审计发现了协议偏离情况。因此，预注册规则无法给出裁决：注册结果为“未确定”（原因代码：C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）。这些数据既不能提供确证性的零结果，也不能……
tldr: 该预注册研究训练64个网络以检验受副本对称破缺启发的权重重叠分布是否随顿悟转变而改变，但由于隐藏单元对齐实现未能保持网络函数等仪器缺陷，最终注册结果被判定为“未确定”（C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID）。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered study trained 64 networks to test whether replica-symmetry-breaking-inspired weight overlap distributions change across the grokking transition, but an alignment implementation that failed to preserve the network function rendered the registered outcome UNDETERMINED (reason code C0_INSTRUMENT_INVALID).
